results.typed: Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents

results.expect: one reply, no duplicate bubbles, sensible tone and casing
results.lastReply:
Here's a relaxed 3-day Jaipur plan with a rest break every afternoon, so your parents aren't rushed.

Day 1, Old city: Hawa Mahal in the morning, then City Palace and Jantar Mantar. Lunch, a rest, and an evening stroll through Johari Bazaar with dinner nearby.
Day 2, Forts: Amer Fort early, before the heat and crowds, with a jeep up the slope instead of the walk. Stop for photos at Jal Mahal, rest after lunch, then watch the sunset from Nahargarh Fort and have dinner there.
Day 3, Easy day and shopping: Albert Hall Museum, Birla Mandir, then Bapu Bazaar for block-print fabrics and jootis. Leave in the afternoon.

A cab with a driver for all three days saves a lot of walking. Winter is the best time to go, as Jaipur is pleasant from now until about March.

Do either of your parents find stairs or long walks hard? I can swap the forts for easier places.
